tagline: Affordable homebuilding across 16 states with move-in-ready homes
hero_kpi_rationale: In 2025, CCS delivered 10,387 homes, demonstrating productive capacity and growth in the residential construction sector. This metric directly reflects operational performance and demand in the affordable housing market.

kpis.name: Homes delivered 2025
kpis.explanation: Total number of homes delivered during the fiscal year
kpis.description: In 2025, CCS delivered 10,387 homes, with 94% having a purchase price below FHA-insured mortgage limits and 99% built as move-in-ready homes.

kpis.name: Affordable housing ratio
kpis.explanation: Percentage of homes delivered with purchase price below FHA mortgage limits
kpis.description: Approximately 94% of homes delivered in 2025 had a purchase price below FHA-insured mortgage limits, reflecting CCS's focus on the affordable housing market.

kpis.name: Move-in-ready homes ratio
kpis.explanation: Percentage of homes delivered built as move-in-ready homes
kpis.description: Approximately 99% of homes delivered in 2025 were built as move-in-ready homes, demonstrating CCS's strategic advantage in faster construction processes and capital deployment.

kpis.name: Number of operating states
kpis.explanation: Number of states where CCS operates its construction activities
kpis.description: As of December 31, 2025, CCS operated in 16 states and over 45 markets, demonstrating its diversified geographic footprint.
